Figure 6: Distribution of TA states across clauses after training. The first half of the literal index range corresponds to original vocabulary features, while the second half corresponds to negated literals. The distribution shows that original literals are mostly pushed toward low states, whereas negated literals form a richer high-state distribution, indicating that absence-based information is important for Omni-style embedding construction.
